name: Plain Marker
description: The one you already have. Always owned.

name: Mossy Marker
description: Reclaimed by moss and time, like something the ground decided to keep.

name: Ornate Monument
description: A grander marker than most heroes get. Premature, but appreciated.

name: Cursed Headstone
description: Something about it makes people not want to look at it directly.

name: Ever-Burning Marker
description: Lit the day it was raised. Nobody's found what's actually fueling it, and nobody's checked too closely.

name: Fallen Knight's Rest
description: Sword, shield, and helm laid at the base -- the old way of marking someone who died with their armor still on.

name: Runestone
description: Carved in a script nobody in the guild can read, with a tankard left at the foot out of habit more than tradition.

name: Blossom Shrine
description: A quieter marker than most -- a blade, a sash, and a tree that only ever blooms here.

name: Frostbound Marker
description: Earned the first time the guild full-clears a Normal raid. Ice doesn't melt here, whatever the season.

name: Dragon's Hoard Marker
description: Earned the first time the guild full-clears a Heroic raid. Something old and scaled has decided this grave is worth guarding.

name: Archmage's Sigil
description: Earned the first time the guild full-clears a Mythic raid. The candles never seem to burn down.

name: Abyssal Ward
description: Earned the first time the guild full-clears a Legendary raid. Something on the other side of that eye is still watching.
